trap.label: account for
trap.wrong: How do you account the drop?
trap.right: How do you account for the drop?
trap.why: Em português “explicar a queda” é transitivo direto. Em inglês, account exige for.

mcq.q: How do you account ___ the drop?
The report ___ the delay by weather.

fix.wrong: How do you account of the drop?
fix.right: How do you account for the drop?

rewrite.prompt: Use account for: “Gas is 40% of emissions.”
Pergunta: “How do you explain the drop?” (account for)
rewrite.answer: How do you account for the drop?
